name: TimeZoneSelect
description:
Choose an IANA time zone by typing a city or region ("hobart", "new york"). Each row shows the
zone's abbreviation and offset now, so daylight saving is visible. The value is the IANA name.
signature: ({ suggested, zones, locale, placeholder, icon, ...rest }: TimeZoneSelectProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only. Applied to the control box.
